secs.h2: Signs Your System Needs to Be Replaced
blocks: p
We always try to repair HVAC systems when we can, but at a certain point, investing in a new, reliable, efficient unit will save you money. Here are the signs that your system needs to be replaced:
ul
Unit is more than ten to 15 years old
System is costing more and more on your energy bills with no change in usage.
The unit frequently breaks down and needs repairs
Your system struggles to control the temperature of your whole home
Frequent short-cycling
Unpleasant odors and unusual, loud noises while the system is running
